Journal 2386 debits 3579.03 and credits 3588.03 (1794.01 + 1794.02), so credits exceed debits by 9.00. Manual accruals are split roughly 50/50 between 2100 and 1200. The expense debit of 3579.03 would split into 1789.51 and 1789.52, so the credit lines look like the mistyped ones (digit transposition: 1794 against 1789). I can't tell from the data which side is wrong, so I'm treating the debit as correct. That choice also gives the smaller fix: a single one-sided debit of 9.00 balances the group, and I put it on the expense account 5500, which was debited in the original.

The period of journal 2386 is closed, so the correcting line goes in open period 11. The original lines plus the correction are then debits 3588.03 and credits 3588.03.

Alternatives such as reducing a credit line by 9.00 would also balance the group. They would put the correction on a liability or prepaid account that I can't confirm is wrong. The debit to 5500 is the only option consistent with the data shown.
